copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app

howto.what: 让AI助手接入Microsoft Teams,通过Chat SDK桥接,能在团队频道、群聊和私聊中收发消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加Teams渠道集成,或提及设置Teams机器人、接入Teams聊天时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加Microsoft Teams渠道支持
say.note: 开始复制适配器并安装集成。

say.text: 把Teams机器人接到我的账号
say.note: 会引导你登录Microsoft 365并创建机器人。

say.text: 设置Teams频道,让消息能发到群里
say.note: 包括创建应用、安装到Teams等步骤。

howto.what_en: Integrates an AI assistant with Microsoft Teams through a Chat SDK bridge, enabling interactive chat in team channels, group chats, and direct messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Microsoft Teams integration, such as setting up a Teams bot or connecting Teams chat.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams channel support to my assistant.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and installing the integration.

say_en.text: Wire the Teams bot to my account.
say_en.note: Guides you through signing in and creating the bot.

say_en.text: Set up Teams so I can chat from a channel.
say_en.note: Includes creating the app and installing it in Teams.
